notes.title: Alpine - The Simulation Game | Update 1.18
notes.content:
A new update for Alpine - The Simulation Game is now available. 

The achievement "Night Owl" has been fixed and the PS4 and Steam versions are now on par thanks to some optimisations on the PS4. 

Among other things, the light artefacts on the Steiner lift have been fixed and there has also been a slight overhaul of the game world. 

We wish you lots of fun with the update! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41120528/d0ba465835740ab299fe53ace8fd139b0ff29219.png[/img]

notes.title: Get to know the first Characters from Alpine - The Simulation Game!
notes.content:
Today, we would like to present some characters from Alpine - The Simulation Game to you.

In the first picture, you can see Bernhard, the manager of the whole ski resort. He is 36 years old and the mayor of Oberbruck.
Due to his young age, Bernhard does not have much experience in his profession yet. However, he is always optimistic and looking forward to your help with the extension of the ski area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41120528/f2fba943348feecbfbedc73f0d84cc5e9d90dd4d.png[/img]

The second picture shows Marlies. She works as a mechanic in the Oberbruck ski resort. 
Marlies is "only" a mechanic, but without her, nothing works in the ski resort. She is aware of that - but she would never take advantage of it. Marlies is always helpful and warm-hearted. She is the good soul of Oberbruck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41120528/d8ffc320ed82cb0cc14340e06b5da3c3c478055d.png[/img]

Bruno is 30 years old and a lift operator in the Oberbruck ski area. 
He is the operator of the Waldeck lift and sometimes a bit too committed when it comes to taking things into his own hands. From time to time, unfortunately, things don't work out the way he imagines, but he always goes to work with the best of intentions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41120528/a2d5e78122f18404bef3f54f0792ebaf5204b139.png[/img]

You can meet many more exciting characters in Alpine - The Simulation Game: Coming to PC and PlayStation 4 on 23th November 2021.

notes.title: Alpine - The Simulation Game | Release Date
notes.content:
Alpine - The Simulation Game will be released on 23th November 2021 for PlayStation 4 and PC. 

Get involved to help the guests of the idyllic mountain village of Oberbruck a skiing experience in a class of its own. Put on your skis and do your swings on the freshly groomed slope! Expand your ski area by mastering exciting challenges with different vehicles and unlock new slopes, lifts and areas of the game world.
All this will await you in "Alpine - The Simulation Game". 

To make sure you don't miss the release, add the game to your Steam Wishlist now and become part of our Discord: https://discord.gg/6nJkxQjdvR
